name: M3_MMS080MI_LstPOHBalance
description: List projected on-hand balance per item and warehouse for a specific planning date. The operation returns multiple records, each showing the expected stock level for one item in one warehouse on the selected date. The projected on‑hand balance starts from the approved on‑hand quantity and then adds planned receipts and subtracts planned issues and reservations, and optionally forecasted demand. Use this to get a compact snapshot of future inventory positions across all or selected items and warehouses, without displaying the underlying material plan transactions.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date for which projected on-hand balances are listed.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company for which projected on-hand balances are listed.

inputParameters.name: FWLO
inputParameters.description: Starting warehouse in the selection range for listing projected on-hand balances.

inputParameters.name: TWLO
inputParameters.description: Ending warehouse in the selection range for listing projected on-hand balances.

inputParameters.name: FITN
inputParameters.description: First item number in the selection range for listing projected on-hand balances.

inputParameters.name: TITN
inputParameters.description: Last item number in the selection range for listing projected on-hand balances.

inputParameters.name: IFOR
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether forecast demand is included when calculating projected on-hand balances.

inputParameters.name: NRCT
inputParameters.description: Option specifying whether reclassification transactions are included when calculating projected on-hand balances.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company to which the item and warehouse belong.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse for which the projected on-hand balance is calculated.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for which the projected on-hand balance is calculated.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date at which this projected on-hand balance applies.

outputParameters.name: PQOH
outputParameters.description: Projected on-hand stock balance for the item and warehouse at the planning date.
